profile.headline: Software Engineer 💳 Cardless
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry, with my most recent role being at Uber on the Uber Works team. I've enjoyed working with various technologies and areas, having discovered a new-found love for being in product and occasionally dabbling in improving my team's infrastructure. My strength lies in full-stack and backend engineering, but I will always aspire to perfect my craft no matter what comes my way.

Outside of engineering, I'm a gamer and a fitness enthusiast (huzzah for power-lifting)!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and built features for Uber Works, which connects businesses to workers and workers to opportunities. Worked on the mobile app and internal ops web app, and was the lead engineer on analytics capture.

- Launched a version of the scheduler system that sharded on types of tasks, reducing load on any single instance. Allowed the business to scale and support 50x the previous load.

- Led the design of and built a tool that allows the operations team to pay workers’ cash incentives via integrating with vendors’ payment API, reducing the workflow to take a few seconds instead of days.

- Implemented push notifications that increased workers engagement with the app (to record timesheet data), reducing time that ops spend on correcting timesheets times by 30%.

- Introduced ETL diffing mechanism that synced analytics data tables in a few seconds instead of 25min+, additionally leading to a decreased cost expenditure on database operations from $1240/mo to $280/mo, a reduction of 78%.

- Migrated a core legacy architecture to a scalable model allowing for a 20% load reduction on scheduler, and speeding up related feature development (for example, a task that would take 2 weeks is reduced to 1 week). The new architecture simplified analytics across related models.

(NodeJS, React/Redux, React Native, Python, API, GCP, Firestore, Segment, Amplitude, Sentry, Logz.io)
positions.insights: Skills: NodeJS · React.js · Redux.js · Flux · ExpressJS · Firebase · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Product Engineering · Logz.io · Sentry · Amplitude · Segment · Firestore · Python

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built systems to drive customer acquisition for Drift’s web chatbot, leading to $700k+ revenue in 2018 and $91k/MRR revenue impact per engineer. The systems detected incoming signals of buyer intent (to purchase Drift) and automated outreach. Projects I’ve designed and built contributing to revenue:

- System that searched for potential customers amongst company-authored LinkedIn posts.
- Automated LinkedIn messaging, outbound to potential leads on behalf of Drift’s sales reps.
- Webhook to ingest real-time install/uninstall events of competitors’ tools from scraped websites.
- System to detect accounts approaching renewal of competitors’ tools, who could then consider Drift as a vendor.

(Java, SQL, Javascript, Python, React/Redux, API, MySQL, Kibana, AWS, Segment, Amplitude)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · API Development · REST APIs

My particular program was "Gender Focus". Volunteers were to volunteer on-site at three different locations, aiding others in their work to better those who are unfortunate:

-The Second Step (http://www.thesecondstep.org/Home.aspx):
Coining the term "A Way from Violence to Self-Reliance", partners of this program dedicate to aiding adult and children survivors of domestic violence by means of providing housing, legal support, financial security, and physical and emotional healing--amongst the many other services provided. Their ultimate goal, as they work in individual, community, and societal levels is to end domestic violence. In FYSOP 21, my group spent a day at a Second Step facility, painting and cleaning up the home and other tasks that eased the lives of those living there.

-Emerge (http://emergedv.com/):
This organization's seeks to eliminate domestic violence in intimate relationships in ways such as educating individual abusers, preventing young people from accepting violence in their relationships, and improve institutional responses to domestic violence while increasing public awareness about the causes and solutions to violence in relationships. In FYSOP 21, my group organized, scanned files, and performed various tasks at an Emerge location.

-Girls Incorporated (http://www.girlsincworcester.org/):
"A national nonprofit youth organization dedicated to inspiring all girls to be strong, smart, and bold." This program provides education for young children (mainly girls), particularly in "high-risk and undeserved areas" in encouraging them to grow up to be independent and fair-minded adults. My group volunteered to play with the children and clean a Girls Inc. facility located in Worcester, Massachusetts.

volunteerExperience.description:
A program run by Boston University's Community Service Center giving the option for incoming freshman for the Fall of 2010 to move into campus one week early and devote that time to volunteer in one of many areas of concern in the Greater Boston area. My particular program was "Gender Focus". Volunteers were to volunteer on-site at three different locations, aiding others in their work to better those who are unfortunate:

-The Second Step (http://www.thesecondstep.org/Home.aspx):
Coining the term "A Way from Violence to Self-Reliance", partners of this program dedicate to aiding adult and children survivors of domestic violence by means of providing housing, legal support, financial security, and physical and emotional healing--amongst the many other services provided. Their ultimate goal, as they work in individual, community, and societal levels is to end domestic violence. In FYSOP 21, my group spent a day at a Second Step facility, painting and cleaning up the home and other tasks that eased the lives of those living there.

-Emerge (http://emergedv.com/):
This organization's seeks to eliminate domestic violence in intimate relationships in ways such as educating individual abusers, preventing young people from accepting violence in their relationships, and improve institutional responses to domestic violence while increasing public awareness about the causes and solutions to violence in relationships. In FYSOP 21, my group organized, scanned files, and performed various tasks at an Emerge location.

-Girls Incorporated (http://www.girlsincworcester.org/):
"A national nonprofit youth organization dedicated to inspiring all girls to be strong, smart, and bold." This program provides education for young children (mainly girls), particularly in "high-risk and undeserved areas" in encouraging them to grow up to be independent and fair-minded adults. My group volunteered to play with the children and clean a Girls Inc. facility located in Worcester, Massachusetts.
